S.FORM: == FAIRY TAIL muo-daw masakapahay FAIRY TAIL 魔導少年 == "FAIRY TAIL muo-daw masakapahay" Dipung a kamu: FAIRY TAIL／フェアリーテイル, ci Cin-taw-haw kini misangaay tu Ci-hun masasiningay a manggaan, itidacn i "masasiningay a cudad Magazine" tusa malebut mihcaan tulu a bataan idaw ku lima nu bangguan katukuh i tusa malabut cacay a bataan idaw ku pitu mihcaan tulu a bataan idaw kusepat nu nikatulinan a bangguan, masacacayay a nika tahekalan pulung han enem a bataan idaw ku tulu nu cudadan. sakalecad nu nipisumadan tu nu tilibu mutiyungay tu sakacacay itida i tusa a malebut idaw ku siwa mihcaan cacay a bataan bulad sabaw tusa demiad katukuh tu tusa malebut cacay a bataan idaw ku tulu mihcaan tulu bulad tulu bataan demiad patahekal i tilibi. "FAIRY TAIL Magazine"2006年35 . sakatusa itida i tusa malebut cacay a bataan idaw ku sepat mihcaan sepat bulad lima demiad katukuh tusa malebut cacay a bataan idaw ku enem mihcaan tulu bulad tusa a bataan idaw ku enem demiad a patahekal i tilubi. sakatulu " FAIRY TAIL ina muo-daw masakapahay nu sadikuday a cudadan" itida i tusa malebut cacay a bataan idaw ku walu mihcaan cacay a bataan bulad pitu demiad katukuh tusa malebut cacay a bataan idaw ku siwa mihcaan siwa bulad tusa bataan idaw ku siwa demiad itida i Tukiw tilibian atu matulinay nu aadihan nu tilibian a patahekal, itida i Dipun nu hekalan a patahekal miadih, idaw ku dumaay nu tusaay mutiyungay a gagagikian. nu layak a nipisulitan han u " muo-daw masakapahay" , ina ka kungkuan musakamu tu Muo-taw-se kunhuy. kikul nu di'tu a tademaw ci Na-ce, Ha-pi, Lu-si atu duma a cabayan, hicaen a misaicelang, sakaycabay atu nikaydaan tu utiihay, demecen milawpes tu kitakiday nu tabakiay a bauan. 第2 .第3期"FAIRY TAIL . ina misulitay ci Cen-daw-haw itida i " Sen-se-wawa" nipicuduhan tu tanayuay matulinay nu cudadan. sakay matulinay nu mangaan " FAIRY TAIL muo-daw masakapahay tu lasubuan a kawaan "フェアリーテイル 100年クエスト" u misulitay a tademaw ku sisikiningay misulit ci Cen-taw-haw, kakenisan misasing , ci Sang-ten-tun-hu kina mikulitay namaka tusa a malebut cacay a bataan idaw ku walu mihcaan pitu bulad tusa bataan idaw ku lima demiad malingatu musa kuamu tu secisia nu APP nika lingatuan katukuh ayda, tu anu cila nu pilipayan a sakatulu demiad misumad tu cacayay nu sasakamuen, patahekal misingding papalahad. ayda tahekalay nu cudadan makaala tu siwa a cudadan, i Taywan nu sulitan u Tunli ku patahekalay tina cudadan, mikaysiakuay han ci U-li-cen. cacay nu di'di'tuan a kitakidan Ya-w-lan-de "Earth Land", yadah i tida ku sapabeli tu Muo-taw-se sapasiwkay tu kawaw nu sakapulungan nu Muo-taw-se' kunhuy, itida i Huy-o-lei-wankuo nu micidekay nu katal a Muo-taw-se yenci nu Muo-taw-se' kunhuy nu sikilulay nu lalimenah "Fairy Tail", cacay ci Sin-lin-muo-taw-se' limucedan ci Lu-si. Ha-te'-huy-li-ya mangalay papilabu tu kikul nu lalimenah. itida ci nida i milawpesay tu tabakiay nu bauan ci Muo-taw-se siningan ci Na-ce. Tuo-la-ke-ni-e aci Ha-pi anililidan, tada ma'dem tu ku nabalucu'an ni Lu-si micumud tu i kikul nu lalimenah yadah ku katinengan tu micidekay nu katal a Muo-taw-se', sisa ci Lu-si aci Na-ce atu Ha-pi mikilul tu sikikulay nu lalimenah a cabayan ci Ke-lei, Ay-e-sa, Wen-ti, Sia-lu-lu atu i kunhuyay a cabayan malingatu mitahaw ku nipiliwkuan. . natangahan 創作 yu mahedek tu ku nipisulitan Rave Master sa, saan ci Cen-taw-han tina kakungkuan sakalaluman sa, sisa mangalay ci nida tu tina manggaan u malaluwaluwahay a kungkuan. ina sasulitan nida namakayda i nikalalipahan nu cabay nida i pacupiyaway. idaw ku nipisulitan tu sakay siningan tu nikatepaan nu heni a kawawan, patinaku u kawaw. ci Cen-taw itida nipikulitan i tusamalebut idaw ku tusa mihcaan siwa bulad tulu demiad itida i ' "Frsh" cudadan nu masacacayay a " nu wawaan a sasakamuan". nika tulinan a kakungkuan namakayda i kalamkamay nu palasitay tu tuu'dan a kakulian micukamas tu silamalay nu lalimenah a tademaw ci Kun-na-ce, idaw ku nipiala nida tu canancanan nu tuu'dan a mikawaw. 在完成了之前的作品 Rave Master "Fresh" . ci Mashima idaw ku ni simsiman nida tu caayay kalecad nu mapalaway itida i tataydaan midang nu nidatengan, kakilulkilul sa ku nipidatengan itini tu i punu', sisa pacician nida ku misulitay a tademaw namakayda i sin-se sumada han tu u mapalaway. ya tapang nu cudad naw " Tale" sumad han "Tail", nipatuduan sa u FAIRY TAIL muo-daw masakapahay, ina misulitay a tademaw saan tu hakiya caay hakiya maluce ku " malucekay". saan ci Cen-taw, amica mangalay ci nida itida i " FAIRY TAIL muo-daw masakapahay" misimsim tu sakalihalay nu udip atu nu katuuday a lihalay, nika u katuuday ku han nida. Mashima .標題由"Tale"改為"Tail",指的是FAIRY TAIL "FAIRY TAIL . misulitay ci Kung-ye-tase aci FAIRY TAIL muo-daw masakapahay sa, u ziwsiw ni Cen-taw cacay tuway, yamikulitay saan, tatengan ina tatuluan nu baluhay a tademaw hicaen hakiya a mitulin tu sakacacay nu mihcaan a utiihay nu kawawan. ci Mashima saan itini i tusa a malebut idaw ku walu nu natangahan nida a misulit tu FAIRY TAIL muo-daw masakapahay tu paypay lipay nu nipianpayan, cacay a lalipayan nu sayaway a demiad misulit tu cudad atu kakungkuan, sakatusa a demiad misinanut tu sulit, sakatulu a demiad katukuh tu sakalima a demiad pail utu nipikulitan, duyu' han tu u mahicaay nu miadupay a tademaw ci Aw-la-ci, nu bulad a cudadan ci Cen-taw milecad tu a misulit. yu nipisulitan nida tu pei'zi milecad tu a misimsim tu baluhay a sasulitan. ci Mashima itida i tusa a malebut idaw ku walu nu mihcaan idaw ku enemay nida a ziwsiwan, itida ku nu heni misakakawaw i walu nu malebutan a kitidaan misulit makaala ku nu heni tu enema a demiadan misakakawaw, idaw ku pituay nu takalan, idaw ku punyi atu sasalamaan tu tilibian. tusa a malebut cacay a bataan idaw ku cacay nu mihcaan , saan ci nida paypilipilipayan enem a demiad ci nida a misakakawaw, sabaw pitu sa ku tuki nida a misakakawaw tu demidemiad. 在創作狂野大師和FAIRY TAIL .Mashima "FAIRY TAIL .Mashima 在 2008 17小時. misuayaw tina cudadan, ci Cen-taw cukaymasen nida ku katinengananay a tademaw. patideng tu Natse atu Igneel nu kalaluwamaan, Mashima micukaymas ci nida tu nikapatayan nu wamanida. makayda ci nida i cabay nida a matineng tu nikasinawal mikacaw tu kadideng, kacaw sa henay ku nu heni tu nipisuyan tu kadideng, imelang tu ci nida. pangangan sa tu nganganasa, ina misulitay a tademaw saan tu nu Amilikaay a nipangangan pasayda i Dipun nu miadihay tina cudadan inayi' ku matinengay sa, sisa mipili' ci nida tu nu laluday nu Dipun a nganganan, Na-ce. Mashima singbungkisya ci Jason misumad tu Amilika nu manggaan nu midaduyay a tademaw Jason Thompson, nikudanay tu tusa a malebut idaw ku walu mihcaan nu Sen-ti-ya-ke i nipatinakuan tu mutiyungay nu manggaan itida a mahumun ci nida, duma sa sumaden tu Del Rey Manga nu cacayay a misakakawaway a tademaw, FAIRY TAIL muo-daw masakapahay nu kalingatuan nu pei-mem pacakayay tu cudada. kilul han nida ku nikaudip tu demidemiadan atu ziwsiw nida tu sakalaluwaluwah nu kamuan ku sakay laluwahan nu sulitan. Natsu 和 Igneel 之間的父子關係時,Mashima Natsu .Mashima 將記者角色 Jason Jason Thompson , Del Rey Manga 的一名員工,FAIRY TAIL .
